title: Ordinary coefficient limit commutes with direct image
statement: For every prime l and finite extension E/Q_l, the coefficient sequence sites and completed coefficient module categories [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] admit an OrdinaryLimitModel l E [def-strict-coefficient-system-realization-data]. Thus the actual sequence direct image [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core] followed by ordinary limit is naturally isomorphic to ordinary limit followed by completed-ring direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and this isomorphism satisfies the actual sectionwise finite projection formula specified by OrdinaryLimitModel.projections.

proof.text: Use the proved unique normalized isomorphism of restricted coefficient towers. This is the actual tower assembled from finite direct-image/evaluation and scalar-restriction comparisons, with identity on every component section.

Use the proved uniquely normalized identification of sfCompletedModuleDirectImage with the actual completed-ring module direct image. Transport the specified module pullback adjunction through this isomorphism. Thus the completed direct image used for the coefficient tower is a right adjoint and preserves ordinary limits.

Apply the limit functor to the tower isomorphism and compose with the inverse of preservesLimitNatIso for the completed direct image. It preserves all limits because it is the right adjoint of the specified module pullback. The equations limMap_pi and preservesLimitIso_inv_pi show that this composite preserves each tower projection up to the finite comparison. Evaluating on sections and using its identity-section formula yields exactly OrdinaryLimitModel.projections. The argument applies equally to zero modules, identity morphisms, empty schemes and arbitrary unbounded coefficient systems.
